title: DiCaprio-linked group buys 52,000 acres on Chilean island; protected status still under negotiation
summary_full: In 2025, Guafo Island in Chile was acquired with a mission: to safeguard its rich wildlife and thwart harmful development. Collaborative efforts between local partners and authorities are vital in securing legal protections for the island. Engaging indigenous communities in resource negotiations enhances respect for local customs while ensuring a strategic management plan, pivotal for the island's ecological integrity and cultural preservation.
